FULL TEXT:
High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Dated : 07/12/2022
NOTIFICATION No. HCG – 03/2022 FOR 14/12/2022
1. Old First Appeals including connected matters relating to MACP cases
as already notified would be listed before the respective Hon’ble Courts
on 14/12/2022.
2. The date assigned matters of 14/12/2022 before above Courts would be
listed on 15/12/2022.
By Order of the Hon’ble The Chief Justice
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
